private static void handleDiceStats(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405,            res.put(\"max\", count * sides + modifier);\n            res.put(\"average\", count * (sides + 1) / 2.0 + modifier);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch          res.put(\"adjusted_xp\", adjustedXp);\n            res.put(\"difficulty\", difficulty);\n            res.put(\"thresholds\", thresholds);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200,
